motion_audit.speed_unit: Image-frame-height per second, not meters or person-height per second
motion_audit.limits: Tracked fraction and finite aggregate speed fraction are not complete-body or identity accuracy. The shared derivative accepts at least 60% valid joint pairs, so 4/6 observed leg joints can produce a speed; case2 is visibly cropped and cannot certify foot/step actions. No calibrated near-static duration or dance threshold is computed. Motion amount and swap difference do not measure musical correctness or caption accuracy. Findings are confined to these three fixed cases, without IID or significance claims.

training_generation_alignment.contrastive_training_readout: L2(audio_head(mean/std time-pool of stereo32D audio latents))
training_generation_alignment.text_training_target: L2(train-stat standardized pooled frozen H3 text last-hidden of genre+MotionScript)
training_generation_alignment.generation_readout: Sequential stereo32D audio latents through original audio patch projection into frozen H3, with separately encoded generic or empty text
training_generation_alignment.bridge_teacher: Original native audio encoder output for the same music, not a caption-conditioned teacher-video prediction
training_generation_alignment.empty_text_definition: One whitespace semantic prompt; no user caption, generic dance template, CoT or soft-token injection. Original reference-label packing and text encoder still run.
training_generation_alignment.image_condition_definition: Reference image anchor (keyframes=None, retake_video=None), not a hard-clamped target first frame
training_generation_alignment.proposed_next_objective: If separately authorized, train the actual empty-text student image+music H3 path against same-noise/time/ref-image caption-conditioned teacher predictions or ground-truth video targets; freeze H3 weights but backpropagate through it into audio encoder/adapter. Explicitly adds generator-level supervision, beyond the prior CLIP/bridge-only restriction.
training_generation_alignment.reference_next_requirement: First fix and verify the chosen no-text reference-preservation interface; do not silently restore semantic prompts. Keep identical image-conditioning policies for every student/teacher control.

verdict: In these three fixed cases, text removal is a major mode change and reduces motion even for native H3. Trained music encoders have not demonstrated faithful source-caption choreography; all empty staircase configurations fail to preserve the reference outfit. Caption-level retrieval alignment has not established generative replacement of text. Preserve user no-text requirement; no automatic retraining, prompt restoration or new video generation performed in this diagnosis.
